newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia wins in S.Korea grassfed beef order.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia wins in S.Korea grassfed beef order.

text.p: Australia won all of South Korea's Livestock Products Marketing Organisation (LPMO) latest tender for 648 tonnes of grassfed fullsets, the Australian Meat and Livestock Corp (AMLC) said in a statement on Monday.
Australia also secured 69.5 percent of the LPMO tender for grassfed quarters, or 2,350 tonnes, it said.
As in the previous tender, New Zealand was not as competitive and secured only 30.5 percent, or 1,030 tonnes, of grassfed quarters, it said.
The U.S. was awarded all of the grainfed cuts tender, it said.
Prices in the latest tender were higher than the previous tender.
On an Australian currency free alongside (AUD FAS) basis equivalent, grassfed fullsets were 3.5 cents a kg higher and grassfed quarters were 19.5 cents a kg above the last tender, it said.
Prices in positions for shipment before April 10 were 298 cents for grassfed fullsets and 175 cents a kg for grassfed quarter beef, both on an AUD FAS basis, AMLC said.
As a result of this tender, Australia's market share in LPMO tenders in the 1997 quota year so far remained high at 41.3 percent against 27.8 percent in the previous corresponding period, it said.
With the latest tender LPMO had purchased 43.1 percent of its 1997 quota, AMLC said.
